blocks.md:
# Interactive page

This notebook page carries **blocks** (text, MCQ, animation), so it opens in the *interactive reader* rather than the plain handwriting editor.

blocks.prompt: Which layer owns touch input in editor mode?
blocks.explain: In editor mode the e-ink daemon owns the pen; the WebView is transparent on top.

## Animation block

The breathing-lungs animation is pure web (SVG + CSS); native just fast-refreshes the region.
